# Notice

This project is a clean modern-Fortran translation of the continuous,
parametric computational core of the R package `rvinecopulib` 0.7.3.1.0.
It is not an official release of `rvinecopulib` or `vinecopulib`.

The translated Fortran source is distributed under GPL-3.0-only, matching the
upstream R package. The complete attached upstream source is retained under
`upstream/rvinecopulib-master` with its original copyright and license files.

The Fortran implementation uses native numerical routines and does not compile
or link the retained C++ headers.
